rationale: B is more useful because it gives a clearer recommendation, defines a decision framework, and distinguishes among alternatives rather than asserting one path. Its KPI framing and sequenced hybrid recommendation better support an actual launch choice. A has a plausible core insight—credibility matters and validator-first helps—but it lacks explicit comparison to other options, weak caveat/revisit handling, and only thin quantitative detail. B is still imperfect, especially on explicit revisit triggers and hard numbers, but it provides more actionable and discriminative reasoning for a careful decision-maker.
